enabled.description:
false = no nudge at all.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

durationMin.description:
Minutes of use until the rail is full. 1 .. 600.

Takes a number 1 .. 600. Default: 50.

pauseMin.description:
An idle span of this many minutes empties even a full rail (a shorter one rewinds part of it). 0.1 .. 120.

Takes a number 0.1 .. 120. Default: 5.

idleGraceSec.description:
Seconds without input that still count as use: a shorter idle rewinds nothing. 1 .. 3600.

Takes a number 1 .. 3600. Default: 30.

rewindPower.description:
How convex the rewind is: 1 = linear in the idle time, 2 = small idles cost little and the cost grows the more idle you are.
0.25 .. 8.

Takes a number 0.25 .. 8. Default: 2.

stepSec.description:
The drawn fill moves only on this beat (seconds): between beats nothing repaints. 1 .. 3600.

Takes a number 1 .. 3600. Default: 60.

stepEaseMs.description:
How long the fill takes to ease to its new place at a beat (milliseconds; 0 = it jumps). 0 .. 5000.

Takes a number 0 .. 5000. Default: 700.

hiddenMin.description:
Minutes of use that are not drawn: the fill appears, easing in from the rail's start, once more than this is banked, and
eases back out when a rewind drops it under. 0 .. 90 % of durationMin.

Takes a number 0 .. 540. Default: 10.
